PAPER VERSION (top row) — Neon Arcade / Miami Sunset, styled from www.expresscollectibles.com: bg #150f2e, neon pink #ff3ea5, cyan #29e6ff, gold #ffc857.
Full-bleed 3.625×2.125 in at 96 px/in; trim = 3.5×2 in.
QR = vCard: name, shop, (618) 882-1041, 906 Broadway, neal@expresscollectibles.com, site + all handles (Whatnot/FB @expresscollectibles, eBay neal_knebel, IG/TikTok @nealknebelofficial). eBay store 'Highland Express Collectibles' = ebay.com/str/expressplug, seller username neal_knebel — the card shows the username.
BEFORE PRINT: bare expresscollectibles.com still shows the Squarespace parking page (card prints the WWW form); make sure neal@expresscollectibles.com exists.
Print files: express-collectibles/business-card/print/ in the repo.

STEEL VERSION (bottom row) — same design translated for a black-steel blank engraved on the xTool, sized to the standard 86×54 mm metal card. Laser is binary, so glows/gradients became solid silver marks and line work; text rows sit on un-engraved keep-out panels so grid lines never cross the type. The QR area engraves as a solid silver plate with the modules left black steel — normal dark-on-light polarity, machine-verified to decode from the mask.
Engrave-ready files: express-collectibles/business-card/engrave/*.png — 1-bit, 600 dpi, exactly 86×54 mm, BLACK = ENGRAVE. In xTool Creative Space: import, set size 86×54 mm, engrave mode, then your material's settings for coated stainless (e.g. F1/S1 presets). Do a test scan of the QR on the first card before running the batch.
